title: Normalized tensor comparison between completed coefficient presentations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its recorded valuation ring and uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$ on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Reuse the quotient identification `integralCoefficientULift`, the finite-level comparison `integralDetailedLevelComparison`, the completed coefficient comparison `integralDetailedCoefficientComparison`, and its derived restriction functor `integralDetailedTransport` from [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. Write the unbounded derived categories $D(R^{\rm pbc}_{E,W})$ and $D(R_{E,W})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $R^{\rm pbc}_{E,W}$ for the continuous-function completed coefficient sheaf [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and $R_{E,W}=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_W$ for the intrinsic presentation [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. The commutative-ring lift $e_{E,W}:R^{\rm pbc}_{E,W}\simeq R_{E,W}$ is uniquely characterized by forgetting to the landed `integralDetailedCoefficientComparison`; its finite projections therefore retain the landed normalization. Restriction along this isomorphism is exact and an equivalence. Write $\Phi_{E,W}:D(R^{\rm pbc}_{E,W})\simeq D(R_{E,W})$ for the inverse of the landed `integralDetailedTransport`, with forward functor expressed as restriction along $e_{E,W}^{-1}$. The round-trip isomorphism is the identity on every ordinary module section, then descended through the exact-functor localization comparisons. This identifies the intrinsic and slice derived-complete predicates [def-weil-derived-complete], without geometric bounds on $W$. Separately, when $W$ is Noetherian, has finite Krull dimension, and $\ell$ is invertible on $W$, the bounded constructible complete predicate [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] is identified with [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] by the landed `integralStratifiedPerfectDetailed`.

For a finite coefficient inclusion $\iota:E\hookrightarrow L$, let $C^{\rm pbc}_{L/E,W}$ be ordinary derived scalar extension over the completed coefficient sheaves [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension], and $C^0_{L/E,W}$ its intrinsic ordinary scalar tensor [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. The ordinary comparison $C^{\rm pbc,ord}_{L/E,W}\Phi^{\rm ord}_{L,W}\simeq\Phi^{\rm ord}_{E,W}C^{0,\rm ord}_{L/E,W}$ is the unique balanced tensor map sending a local pure tensor $a\otimes x$ to $e_{L,W}(a)\otimes x$. Define its derived comparison $C^{\rm pbc}_{L/E,W}\Phi_{L,W}\simeq\Phi_{E,W}C^0_{L/E,W}$ as the unique natural isomorphism whose value on every cochain-complex representative commutes with the universal derived tensor counits, the exact restriction localization factors and that termwise ordinary tensor comparison. Finite-free scalar extension is exact, so this normalization applies to every complex, without an extra flatness hypothesis.
